evals.name: humanize-exec-memo
evals.prompt: Humanize this exec memo paragraph: 'In today's fast-paced landscape, it is crucial that we leverage a comprehensive approach...'
evals.expected_output: Removes detector-like phrases, varies rhythm, preserves facts, and returns production-ready prose plus a brief audit.

evals.name: preserve-technical-meaning
evals.prompt: Humanize a technical PRD excerpt without changing metric names, dates, or constraints.
evals.expected_output: Keeps all load-bearing facts intact while reducing formulaic AI tone and explaining any changes that affect register.
